mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses the discount rate for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.1% in the prior month, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% and rising by more than 0.1 percentage points over the past three months signals an economic slowdown that prompts the Federal Reserve to ease monetary policy, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.5 and UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 3 months
evidence_refs: doc:Federal Reserve policy response to unemployment
regime_hint: economic slowdown with impending monetary easing
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 5.5% and rises by more than 0.1pp in 3 months, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline of more than 0.5% in both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior month signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to an expectation of Federal Reserve rate cuts and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 0.5% and RSAFS declines > 0.5% in the prior month
evidence_refs: doc:Historical Fed response to concurrent housing and retail weakness
regime_hint: economic slowdown with concurrent weakness in housing and retail
failure_condition: In instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 0.5% in the prior month, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-growth expansion regime, a monthly increase in industrial production above 0.5% signals potential economic overheating and the expectation of Federal Reserve rate hikes, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
evidence_refs: doc:Historical Fed rate hikes during high-growth expansions
failure_condition: In high-growth expansion regimes, when INDPRO increases by more than 0.5% in the prior month, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payrolls above 100,000 jobs compresses the unemployment rate and signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS increases by more than 100,000 in the prior month, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% indicates an active monetary tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: doc:Historical market reaction to Fed rate hikes
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 0.5% and a decline in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) by more than 0.2% signals an imminent recession, prompting the Federal Reserve to cut rates, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In instances where HOUST declines by more than 0.5% and GDPC1 declines by more than 0.2%, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-growth recovery regime, a monthly increase in industrial production above 0.5% signals an economic rebound, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: doc:Historical market reaction to industrial production growth in recovery phases
failure_condition: In low-growth recovery regimes, when INDPRO increases by more than 0.5% in the prior month, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
